versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "石油工程油藏论文写作专家团（部署器）".
- One-click deployment of a reservoir engineering academic writing expert team to the WorkBuddy expert directory.
- Supports the full research paper workflow with 8 specialized roles: topic selection, data collection, drafting, fact-checking, style revision, peer review, and formatting.
- Integrates key journal standards and academic databases (OnePetro, CNKI, SCI) for streamlined research and writing.
- Includes an automated deployment script and clear uninstall instructions.
- Requires WorkBuddy platform with multi-agent support.
